title: The Lighthouse Keeper’s Feather

scenes.text: Bramble discovers mysterious symbols near a lighthouse.
scenes.image_prompt: bear examining carved stone near lighthouse in fog

scenes.text: They seek help and learn the symbols are instructions to hidden treasure.
scenes.image_prompt: old otter explaining symbols to bear and fox

scenes.text: They follow clues across hills and back to the lighthouse.
scenes.image_prompt: hilltop with carved stone pointing direction

scenes.text: Rook the raven warns them about the treasure’s power.
scenes.image_prompt: dark raven confronting bear and fox on moor

scenes.text: They solve a puzzle inside the lighthouse and discover the hidden cache.
scenes.image_prompt: secret door opening inside lighthouse wall

story: Bramble and Juniper follow ancient symbols to uncover a hidden treasure. Along the way, they learn that responsibility matters more than riches.
